label: First Way mover is necessary, from firstness, unreceivedness and C2
description: Same-witness conditional result: the First Way's own first mover is pure act and exists at every world accessible from w, from the prima via conclusion, B0, firstness, unreceivedness and C2, with excluded middle. Not a transcription: no premise mentions necessity. Establishes no premise. Pure actuality, unreceived esse, underivedness and necessary existence stay four distinct propositions; POTENCY_1 pure act is carried, not used. C2 is weaker than both R1 with De ente and B2 with B3 (controls, laws 3-4), and independent of the pure-act target (controls).
